Trigger A creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell.

You send the effect nowhere. It is expended with no result.

Ascendant: once per round. Zenith: no frequency limit, and once per minute you may instead target a creature within 60 feet — Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC, and on a critical failure it is teleported one mile away (incapacitation).

Granted by the Aries Ascendant and Zenith Boons.
